name: A Dynamite Plan
objectiveText: Obtain 10 Rough Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. Rough Dynamite  ( 10 )

comments.body: The quest now requires 10 Rough Dynamite as of Oct 1st Beta update.  Quest text still reads as 10 Coarse.
Note that with the October 1 beta update, this quest now requires Rough Dynamite, not Coarse Dynamite, and so the cost is much cheaper.

I don't think you need to do the dynamite part. I just noticed when that part of the chain came he already had Detonation at a Distance. So I think you can skip that part. Didn't realize it till I had already bought 10 dynamite :(
replies: I was required to complete this to continue the chain as of the Oct 1st Beta update.

comments.body: Is this questline even worth it? Costs almost 1 gold to buy 10 Coarse Dynamite.
